scope: Pre-frozen exploratory cohort; no candidate replacement, no population quantum success claim. Target/seed assignment is matched across policies but not independently crossed.
protocol: PBE0/def2-TZVP/DF(def2-universal-jkfit), grid3, SCF1e-8; PBE-D3BJ/def2-TZVP optimization max80; distinct from source FHI-aims Tier2/PBE-TS.

selection.selection: Predeclared terminal top1 A distance and fixed hash; no B/DFT selection or missing-slot replacement.
